item.title: 【Albums (lossy)】MP3 - Madonna - Drowned World Tour 2001 (Live Album, Unofficial Release)
item.description:
Hello everyone,
since there is unfortunately no official live album release of Madonna's Drowned World Tour 2001, I decided to create one myself.

I extracted the audio (Dolby Digital 2.0 Stereo) from the official tour DVD and split it into individual tracks using Audacity. I then exported the tracks as MP3 files (MPEG Audio Layer 3, 320 kb/s CBR, 48.0 kHz, Joint Stereo). In my opinion, the track separation from the DVD menu was not suitable for a proper live album. For some songs, the beginning of the track was cut off, while others started with a long section of unnecessary crowd noise and cheering before the actual song began. I adjusted the track boundaries to create a better listening experience, especially when listening to individual tracks rather than the entire album from beginning to end.

Btw., I also shared an ISO backup of the Drowned World Tour 2001 DVD on this forum: click here to see the thread.
